_comment: MCP servers, in the standard `mcpServers` shape consumed by
ToolFamily is our own mapping, in smartops.tools.registry.
Credentials are ${VAR} references resolved against the process
environment, so no secret belongs in this file. An unset variable raises
inside load_servers() and, because every server sets continue_on_error,
that server is skipped rather than aborting the run -- which is how this
config behaves correctly with no credentials at all.
Override this file's location with SMARTOPS_MCP_CONFIG.
edr and ndr are disabled because no vendor has been picked. To enable one,
add its `url` and `headers` and drop `disabled`. Keep entries free of extra
keys -- Strands warns about anything outside its MCPServerConfig schema.
